title: The next rep

sources.title: Combining motivational and volitional interventions to promote exercise participation
sources.scope: A short-term experiment found benefits of combined motivation and implementation planning. No numerical claim is made in this film.

sources.title: The Limits of Simple Implementation Intentions: Evidence from a Field Experiment on Making Plans to Exercise
sources.scope: Counterevidence: simple plans did not increase gym attendance in this field experiment. The film frames planning as a practical experiment, not a guarantee.

evidence_boundary: Planning does not guarantee exercise adherence; this film suggests an experiment. Voice and visuals portray no real individual.
original_script: Tomorrow, I'll train. A promise can be clear. And the next step can still be missing. Give it a place. At six, after class, I'll walk through the gym doors. Then give it a first move. Bag down. Phone away. Warm-up set. A specific plan won't lift the weight for you. It's one decision to try when the day gets loud. Choose the cue. Name the next action. Then make that action real.
